newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's NLCF seeks 210,000 tonnes of corn.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's NLCF seeks 210,000 tonnes of corn.

text.p: South Korea's National Livestock Cooperatives Federation (NLCF) said it has invited tenders to buy a total of 210,000 tonnes of corn by 3:00 p.m. (0600 GMT) on Thursday.
An NLCF official said it was seeking the amount in four positions, each for 52,500 tonnes, and invited tenders for worldwide origins.
Arrival for the first position was set for May 5, the second for May 25, the third for August 10 and the last for August 30 to the ports of Inchon and Ulsan, he said.
